candidate_evidence.quote: The trial aims to evaluate the safety and tolerability of autologous dendritic cell injection sensitized with tumor neoantigens (YS247) in participants with recurrent or progressive glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Recurrence/progression confirmed by MRI after standard therapy (surgery, Stupp protocol)

role_evidence.quote: Tumor Neoantigen-pulsed Autologous Dendritic Cell Injection (YS247) in Patients with Recurrent or Progressive Glioblastoma

agents.drug_class_hint: personalised tumour neoantigen-pulsed autologous dendritic cell vaccine (YS247), subcutaneous

coder_notes: Registered phase NA. Only intervention is a neoantigen-pulsed autologous dendritic cell vaccine (excluded intervention type). Pharmacodynamic immune monitoring (neoantigen-specific T cells by ELISpot, flow, TCR sequencing) is planned but relates to the excluded vaccine, not a candidate, so target_engagement coded no. Tumour NGS is required to design the personalised neoantigens, not as a biomarker selection, so no biomarker row. 'GBM (WHO Grade IV)' without IDH or WHO edition reference coded cns5 unclear.
